methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: this paper presents a cost-efficient holistic framework to acquire and analyze energy data as an essential step in improving the energy efficiency of production machines

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper develops a data acquisition and analysis system (ETAS: hardware + Raspberry Pi App + Web App) for production machines. Energy performance indicators appear only as a downstream capability of the tool, and the sole computed indicator is the non-production time factor (a time-utilisation ratio, ref. 18) used to demonstrate the framework exemplarily. No EnPI/EnB measurement model relating or normalising energy is presented or characterised, so the v2.3 rule excluding tools/frameworks/software without EnPI/EnB measurement-model content applies.

paper_type.evidence_quote: an energy transparency and analysis system is being developed that can measure, record and analyze electrical quantities

stage1.notes: Borderline eligibility: repeatedly invokes 'energy performance indicators' and computes the NPTF, but only to demonstrate a measurement/analysis tool; no energy-normalising EnPI/EnB model is constructed. Context is discrete manufacturing (lathe, cleaning machine), so level_3b is false regardless. Flag for human review of the eligibility call.
